lines: Goodbyes get stuck deep in my throat.
I said thank you as if I were coughing.
Even if I search my pockets for the next words,
All I find is me, still loving you.
I'm fine, it's okay, I think I've become gentle.
It turned into a wish, and in the end became a lie.
It withers away, still blue.
I fade away, still loving you.
Take me up like a doll.
I crushed it together with the feelings that lay deep inside.
It's okay, it's okay.
Hold me right now.
If I'm here, you need nothing.
Just say that and kiss me.
Just kidding, it's a lie, I'm sorry.
I know this isn't the time to recall it, but...
Saying you won't leave me alone actually made me happy.
You gathered courage and called me for the first time.
I wonder what differs from me that night.
No matter how far apart we are, however much we can't meet,
My feelings haven't changed, so I'm still here.
It withers away, still blue.
I fade away, still loving you.
Remember me forever.
Just kidding, it's a lie, stay well.
You, with a slightly relieved face, looking at my uncrying self.
You're still as carefree as ever, and I love that too.
When I notice, you're beside me.
I wish you'd just stay the way you are.
You wiped away tears on your own, didn't you?
Everything I see, everything I hear, everything.
You even colored it.
It withers away, still blue.
I fade away, still loving you.
Take me up like a doll.
I crushed it together with the feelings that lay deep inside.
It's okay, it's okay.
Hold me right now.
If I'm here, you need nothing.
Say that and don't let go anymore.
Just kidding, it's a lie, goodbye.
